name: What can go wrong if trim damage is repaired the wrong way?
description: Bad repairs can trap moisture, hide rot, or fail early. If the underlying cause is not fixed, the damage often returns.

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong if trim damage is repaired the wrong way?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risks are hidden rot, water intrusion, mismatched materials, and repairs that only cover the surface without fixing the cause. On exterior trim, a poor seal or bad paint prep can lead to the same problem coming back, especially after Colorado freeze-thaw cycles.
